department_or_school: Department of Dietetics and Nutrition, Robert Stempel College of Public Health and Social Work
spring_2027_deadline: Not verified (the department page describes only a Fall start)
fall_2027_deadline: February 15 standing deadline: department page says applications 'are due February 15th to begin in the Fall' and that the program follows University dates and deadlines. This points to 2027-02-15 for Fall 2027, but no 2027-specific date was seen (the search tool says the page is about 255 days old).
funding_deadline_note: PhD handbook: applicants should consult the FIU Graduate School and Stempel College web sites for differing deadlines for fellowship and assistantship applications.
funding_summary: PhD handbook: 'most Graduate Teaching and Research Assistantships include a stipend and tuition waivers'; students typically work about 20 hours per week with faculty or teaching. FIU Graduate Assistant Handbook 2026-2027: the waiver covers 9 graduate credits in Fall and Spring and 6 in Summer (3 dissertation credits after candidacy); only 20-hour contracts include the waiver and subsidized insurance; 10-hour contracts get a stipend plus a waiver of only the out-of-state portion of tuition. Conditionally admitted students are not eligible. No stipend amount seen, and the number of funded PhD slots is not stated.
assistantship_types: GTA and GRA ('Graduate Teaching and Research Assistantships', PhD handbook)
assistantship_covers: 20 hr/week contract: stipend + tuition waiver (9 credits Fall/Spring, 6 Summer) + subsidized health insurance (FIU GA Handbook 2026-2027). Stipend amount Not verified.
assistantship_deadline: Not verified (handbook points to Graduate School and Stempel College pages)
notes: Strong fit on paper: IELTS 6.5 accepted and assistantships carry a stipend + tuition waiver. Spring 2027 entry is unlikely (Fall start only described). The department also runs an M.S. in Dietetics and Nutrition (MS handbook: https://stempel.fiu.edu/students/orientation/ms-handbook-june27-2025.pdf); MS funding was not verified.
